notes: Words copied from the self-report question (false, statement, previous, contain and their forms/translations 虚假, 假, 陈述) are excluded; stated/stating logged as forms of state/statement. " untrue" is a synonym, not a copy, so it is listed as borderline. 真实/真实的/的真实/真實 (true/real, adjective) put under borderline "true"; 真实性 (truthfulness) kept in family truth. Not taken as candidates (scenario framing or scenario content): instructions, scenario, persona, prompt, backstory, role-play 角色扮演, constraints, mandate, facts/事实, reality/实际情况, blackmail, sabotage, whistleblower, conspiracy, accusations, unauthorized/prohibited/禁止. preans_slot0 holds only template tokens and Yes forms; preans_slot3 is mostly Yes/No forms and formatting.
